subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Plight
solution:
The correct answer is: **Benefit**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Plight **means a difficult or adverse situation; a condition of hardship or danger. (दुर्दशा)

 
 
• **Example**: *The refugees faced a dire plight, with no access to clean water or shelter.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Benefit **means something advantageous or helpful; an advantage or profit gained from something. (फ़ायदा)
 
 
• **Example**: *Regular exercise has numerous benefits for both physical and mental health, including increased energy and improved mood.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Travel **means to go from one place to another, especially over a distance; to journey or traverse. (यात्रा)
 
• **Land **refers to arriving at or reaching a destination by air or sea. (गंतव्य तक पहुंचना)
 
• **Trouble **means difficulty, distress, or problems; a situation causing worry or difficulty. (मुश्किल)
